import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 4, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (4, 10))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
df['score'] = rng.exponential(scale=1.0, size=n)
df['cat'] = [f'g{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: open explore tab and set size column to score
steps.eval: document.querySelector('#tab-explore').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const scoreIdx = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'score').index; a.setSizeColumn(scoreIdx)
